# Deeptanium

**Deeptanium** is a solid (drilled tile by tile) ore. Each extraction yields **1.5k** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/es/formats/ore-fields/).

## Extracción

| Property | Valor |
|---|---|
| Cantidad / extracción | 1.5k |
| Tipo de extracción | solid (drilled tile by tile) |
| Efecto activador | no requerido |
| Documento de geo-escaneo | definition 8671 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
